{{Top|leg}}
'''Ransom''' was a subscriber to, and commenter on, ''[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]''. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Ransom commented on the entry for the [[LE-VO law enforcement droid]], citing it was almost a pleasure to confront them because their programming meant they never shot to kill.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], commenting on the entry for the [[Class I Defense Droid]], Ransom relayed information that the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] had deployed several Class Is against of the few remaining [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Ransom commented on the entry for the [[FLR-series Logger Droid]], complaining that the problem with the droid was that [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] made them too user-friendly. The result was a droid that took forever to program since the unit would constantly check if the user's commands were really what they wanted to program into the droid.<ref name="CFTD" />
